answer: Behavioral Fingerprint Clustering. Agents get a private cedar key that signs every action, so each identity leaves a persistent action trace. After the fact, auditors cluster traces by timing rhythm, tool-call order and error patterns; Sybil rings collapse into one behavioral mode even when wallets differ. A violet audit queue flags matches; matching identities lose their copper credit line and future payouts. Each fake identity must simulate a distinct behavioral profile indefinitely, costing continuous manual scripting.
